item.title: She died covering the Ukraine war for Fox News; her parents blame the network and a star reporter
item.description: Relatives of two Fox News journalists killed while covering the Ukraine war are suing the network, alleging it prioritized the story over their safety.

item.title: Latter-day Saints women distance themselves from scandal-hit Arizona Republican candidate
item.description: Arizona Republican congressional candidate Mark Lamb has faced sexual misconduct accusations from his time as sheriff, prompting many voters to turn away.

item.title: Coast Guard locates debris from medical jet with 6 aboard
item.description: Flight data indicates the jet descended at least 9,000 feet in two minutes, then leveled off for several minutes before vanishing.

item.title: Cornell lawsuit and campus safety changes
item.description: Universities have obligations when students report sexual assault, even without charges. Attorney Baine Kerr explains how those responsibilities work.
